_doc: Reference-plate manifest for Flowering Crabapple (Malus 'Prairifire'). Stage-0 source list; binaries download in Stage-1 ingest (downloaded:false). Jacob ratifies identification (ratified:false).
identityNotes: Modeled on Malus 'Prairifire', the dominant disease-resistant ornamental cultivar in the St. Louis region (MoBot Plant Finder). If actual park trees are another cv., genus-level traits (broad-rounded habit, spring blossom, small persistent pomes) still hold. SMALL tree (~6 m) — the ornamental-chassis gap.

plates.credit: Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder — Malus 'Prairifire'
plates.caption: Broad-rounded habit, dark green summer foliage; authoritative cultivar profile (pull the spring-bloom plate here).
Golden-bronze fall foliage with persistent purplish-red fruit clusters.
Ornamental crabapple scaly reddish-brown bark; no cultivar-specific Commons file confirmed.
